phrase: A chip maker moved to oust its CEO after a second affair surfaced. A school's AI left a teenager's suicide-related messages unflagged for weeks.
phraseAlternatives: A chip maker weighed firing its CEO over a new affair. A school's AI failed to flag a teenager's suicide-related chats for weeks.
One company debated removing its own chief executive after a second affair came to light. One school's AI missed a student's warning signs for weeks.
A chip maker's board moved toward firing its chief executive. Meanwhile, a school's AI chat monitor missed a teenager's crisis for weeks.
While a chip maker weighed firing its CEO over scandal, a school's AI monitoring system missed a teenager's suicide-related messages for weeks.
alt: Blueprint diagram split in two. Left: a yellow-hinged trapdoor opens in a company building's boardroom floor, and a worried executive falls through it with a briefcase. Right: a school laptop glows with a quiet chat bubble beside a flag barely risen on its pole above a tall stack of calendar pages labeled weeks later. A dashed line links the two halves like shared wiring on one drawing.

brief.concept: A company's boardroom floor drops away beneath its own chief executive while, across town, a school laptop's quiet chat alert takes weeks to finally rise.
brief.metaphor: Two alarms ring at very different volumes: one a deafening boardroom scandal, the other a safety flag that barely moves.

cast.who: a company building with a trapdoor opening in its boardroom floor
a worried tech executive standing on the trapdoor, briefcase in hand
a school laptop with a small chatbot speech bubble glowing inside its screen
a tiny alert flag slowly climbing a pole above the laptop, over a tall stack of calendar pages

brief.composition: Split scene on a fine blueprint grid. Left half: a company building with its boardroom trapdoor open, the executive mid-fall with a briefcase, one yellow highlight on the trapdoor hinge. Right half: a school laptop at a child's desk, a soft chat bubble glowing on its screen, a small flag inching up a pole beside a tall stack of calendar pages marking the weeks. A thin dashed line connects the two halves like shared wiring on the same technical drawing.
